meta.name: rules
meta.description: Use when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询和配置 Codex Rules 的行为与规则文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要了解或调整 Codex 的规则行为
copy.tagline_en: Query and configure Codex Rules behavior and rule files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand or adjust Codex rule behavior

howto.what: 启用插件后自动运行：在会话开始和提交提示词时注入静态项目指令，默认在 Codex apply_patch 之后注入匹配的文件规则。动态输出按会话去重后作为附加上下文，且不改写工具输出。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Codex Rules 的行为、注入的项目规则、支持的规则文件位置等，或问规则匹配与环境配置时触发。

say.text: Codex Rules 支持哪些规则文件位置？
say.note: 会列出 CONTEXT.md、.omo/rules 等来源

say.text: 把 CODEX_RULES_MODE 设为 static 会怎样？
say.note: 只保留静态规则，关闭动态注入

say.text: CONTEXT.md 里的规则什么时候被注入？
say.note: 会话开始与提交提示词时

howto.what_en: Once enabled, it runs by itself: static project instructions are injected on SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit, and matching file rules after Codex apply_patch. Dynamic output is deduplicated per session as extra context.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

say_en.text: Which rule file locations does Codex Rules support?
What happens if I set CODEX_RULES_MODE to static?
say_en.note: keeps static rules only; dynamic off

say_en.text: When are rules in CONTEXT.md injected?
say_en.note: on session start and prompt submit
